title: Senior Technical Executive (Government Tendering)
description:
***Role Overview:***




 We are looking for a technically strong and detail\-driven professional to manage and support end\-to\-end government bidding activities. **Key Responsibilities:** 




***Tender \& Compliance Management:***




 • Analyze tender/RFP documents and identify technical requirements • Prepare clause\-by\-clause technical compliance statements • Identify deviations and draft queries for pre\-bid meetings • Develop datasheets, technical documents, and compliance matrices • Validate eligibility criteria including certifications, specifications, and OEM authorizations 
 



***Technical Pre\-Sales Support:***




 • Understand and position networking products such as Switches, Routers, Access Points, Controllers, and Transceivers • Recommend suitable product models based on RFP requirements • Coordinate with partners for technical clarifications, BoM, and compliance documents • Ensure proposed solutions meet all technical and certification standards.
 



***Coordination \& Tracker Management:***




 • Maintain tender tracker, compliance tracker, and query tracker • Coordinate with sales, partners, finance, and management teams for submissions • Monitor key milestones: pre\-bid meetings, submission deadlines, and evaluations • Maintain organized documentation repository for all tenders.
 



  





***Certifications \& Documentation:***




 • Work with certifications such as TEC, BIS, WPC, CE, FCC, RoHS, ISO, IPv6 Ready, Common Criteria • Ensure availability and validity of all required certifications before submission  
 



  





***Key Deliverables:***




 • Tender Compliance Submission • Bill of Materials (BoM) Preparation • Technical Query Documentation • Product Comparison Sheets • Tender Tracker Maintenance • Complete Bid Documentation 
 



  





***Required Skills:***




 • Strong knowledge of L2/L3 Switches, Routers, Access Points, Wireless Controllers, SFP/Transceivers • Understanding of VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, Routing, PoE, Fiber, SFP types, Basic Wireless • Proficiency in MS Excel (trackers, compliance sheets, comparison sheets) • Strong documentation and professional email communication skills  
 



  





***Preferred Industry Experience:***




 • Government Tendering • Networking OEM / System Integrator • Telecom / IT Networking Industry
 



  





***Experience \& Education:***




 • 2 – 5 Years ( Networking / Telecom OEM) • Degree / Diploma in: • B.Tech / BE / Diploma in Electronics / IT / Computer / Telecom • B.Sc / BCA with Networking Knowledge

description:

**Diversity \- Innovation \- Caring \- Global Collaboration \- Winning Spirit \- High Performance**

**Location:**

**Job Description**
* Sells and promotes company products within a defined geographic territory by developing new accounts and expanding usage of company products by current accounts in an effort to meet a sales quota based on company sales goals and to directly increase sales revenue of the company.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Sells products by scheduling sales calls to meet with current and potential customers to fulfill revenue and unit growth objectives assigned by company on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.
* Develops and implements sales strategies by determining the relevant factors (e.g., product, competition and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote the company's products to appropriate hospital personnel and physicians.
* Develops action plans (i.e., weekly, quarterly, monthly) by analyzing quarterly and monthly sales figures and reports identifying the needs of particular accounts and discussing issues with Regional Manager to help the organization achieve its annual sales goals.
* Determines the needs (e.g., product and pricing), goals, product usage, and types of cases handled by specific customers by meeting with and asking in\-depth questions of physicians and other hospital personnel to learn which Boston Scientific products can best address their specific needs.
* Observes actual procedures in the cardiac catheterization lab and operating room of hospital accounts to gain insight into the specific nuances of each physician and each member of the lab staff.
* Establishes pricing packages by working with relevant Boston Scientific personnel to establish price points that address specific customer's needs while satisfying company guidelines and policies.
* Responds to customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g. clinical research, pricing and/or marketing) to develop optimal solutions.
* Develops relationships with hospital personnel (e.g. through casual conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and to identify key purchasing decision makers in order to facilitate future sales.
* Educates customers on the merits and proper clinical usage of company products by giving presentations and demonstrations using a wide variety of formats and platforms (e.g., slides, transparencies, manuals) to secure purchasing commitments, often with the help of incentive programs and services made available to the account being developed.


**Must Have**
 5\+ Years of individual role experience
   

  

 Must have experience in Intervention Cardiology OR any cardiology therapy areas

* For those individuals that supervise others, the following statements are applicable:
* Assures that appropriate resources (personnel, tools, etc.) are maintained in order to assure Quality System compliance and adherence to the BSC Quality Policy.


 2\.2\. Establishes and promotes a work environment that supports the Quality Policy and Quality System.
   

  

 Knowledge
   

  

* A developing professional. Working knowledge and application of business and technical concepts, procedures and practices. General knowledge of industry practices, techniques, and standards. General understanding of business unit/group function. Exercises judgment when interpreting company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues.


 Problem Solving
   

  

* Develops solutions to a variety of problems of moderate scope and complexity where analysis of situations or data requires a review of identifiable factors. Exercises judgment to determine appropriate action. Has knowledge of alternatives and an understanding of their impact on the business or technological environment.


 Planning and Organization
   

  

* Plans, organizes, and prioritizes own daily work routine to meet established schedule

 631225
   

  

 Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. title: Hubspot (Revops & Presales)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mavlers is a global digital marketing and technology partner that supports organizations as a scalable, behind\-the\-scenes growth engine. With over 90,000 projects delivered by a team of 800\+ professionals across more than 52 countries, Mavlers collaborates with leading brands such as Disney, National Geographic, Incubeta, and Ogilvy. The company provides integrated services across CRM, MarTech, SEO, PPC, and Web Development, offering flexible teams that align with client workflows and business objectives. Mavlers focuses on co\-owning outcomes, helping clients expand services, onboard more customers, and achieve sustainable growth without the cost of large in\-house teams. Through thought leadership content, including the Marketing Insider Series and in\-depth blogs, Mavlers shares practical strategies and insights that drive measurable impact.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a part\-time remote role for a HubSpot (RevOps \& Presales) specialist at Mavlers. The role involves configuring and optimizing HubSpot CRM and associated RevOps processes, including pipeline setup, automation, reporting, and data hygiene to support sales and marketing alignment. The specialist will participate in presales activities such as requirement discovery, solution design, demos, and documentation that clearly communicate how HubSpot can address client needs. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with internal teams and prospective clients, preparing proposals and scopes of work, creating playbooks and process documentation, and supporting onboarding and handover to delivery teams. The individual will also analyze performance metrics, recommend operational improvements, and contribute to best practices for HubSpot usage across client engagements.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret CRM data, optimize pipelines, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for stakeholder collaboration, client presentations, and clear documentation.
* Candidates should possess Consulting capabilities to understand business processes, propose HubSpot\-based solutions, and guide RevOps improvements.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage client expectations, provide responsive support, and build long\-term relationships.
* Candidates should possess Presales experience, including discovery, solution mapping, demo preparation, and contributing to proposals.
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot CRM, Marketing, and Sales hubs, including workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Knowledge of revenue operations best practices across marketing, sales, and customer success functions.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage part\-time schedules, and prioritize multiple client requests.
* Experience in digital marketing, SaaS, or agency environments is preferred; certifications in HubSpot or RevOps are an advantage.
